xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5349: pan open <path>: open files and folders in Overdeck, plus an opt-in right-click 'Open in Overdeck' in the OS file manager

plan.title: pan open <path>: open files and folders in Overdeck, plus an opt-in right-click 'Open in Overdeck' in the OS file manager
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: About 55 files across contracts, server, frontend, CLI, desktop and docs. One issue because the operator filed and specified both halves together, and the right-click integration's only behavior is running `pan open`, so its live check cannot pass before part 1 lands. A sibling issue would block on this one with no parallelism gain: the integration items (file-manager-planner, pan-integrate-cli, install-step, doctor-check) have no edges to the dashboard items and already run in parallel inside this plan.

narratives.Problem: Nothing in Overdeck opens an arbitrary file or folder. There is no deep link for a path, no server-to-browser command channel, and no file-manager integration. `pan open <id>` only opens an issue workspace in an external editor.
narratives.Proposal: `pan open <target>` resolves a path (or path:line:col, or issue) and POSTs it to a new `POST /api/ui/open`, which maps it to an explorer root with a shared `resolvePathRoot` and publishes a transient UiCommand on a new `pan.subscribeUiCommands` RPC stream. The most recently focused dashboard tab opens a folder in the Files dock or a file in a code pane of the right project's deck. With no tab open the CLI opens `/open?path=…`. `--editor` keeps the old editor behavior. `pan integrate file-manager [--remove] [--dry-run]` writes per-user Linux (Open With, GNOME script, Dolphin menu), macOS (Quick Action) and Windows (HKCU keys) entries that call `pan open`; `pan install` offers it opt-in and `pan doctor` warns when it is stale. The desktop app handles `--open <path>` and raises its window.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Registering Overdeck as the default handler for any file type, or adding fileAssociations to the desktop package.
- Opening paths on linked (remote) machines.
- Routing pan open to the desktop app's embedded server (port 7825+) when no pan up dashboard runs.
- Storing UI commands or replaying them to tabs that subscribe later.
- Reading file contents or listing directories in POST /api/ui/open.
- Special viewers for non-text files beyond today's code pane.
- Line/column positioning in external editors.
- Opening a path outside every project without registering it first.
- Starting the dashboard automatically from pan open.
- Editing components/Stage/index.tsx.
- Any system-wide (root) install or writing outside the user's home for the integration.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the whole issue (pan open + file-manager integration + desktop) in one plan with sizeJustification instead of sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator filed both halves together; the integration only calls pan open so its live check needs part 1; integration items already run in parallel inside the DAG.

autoDecisions.summary: Store integration state in ~/.overdeck/integrations/file-manager.json instead of config.yaml (PRD O-D11 originally said config.yaml).
autoDecisions.rationale: config.yaml is normalized and rewritten by dashboard settings doors; a CLI-only install record read by doctor is safer in its own file, which also records the exact files to remove.

autoDecisions.summary: Leader-tab rule: leader acts, followers wait 750 ms for a BroadcastChannel 'handled' ack, missing/stale entry means every visible tab acts; the leader clears its entry on pagehide.
autoDecisions.rationale: The original 'lowest visible tabId' rule needs a tab registry that does not exist, and a closed leader tab would have silently swallowed every command.

autoDecisions.summary: UI command hub is a module-level PubSub singleton, not an Effect layer.
autoDecisions.rationale: Both the HTTP route and the ws-rpc handler import it without editing server.ts layer wiring, and the name avoids the existing PanOpen service.

autoDecisions.summary: Add-project prefill opens the existing modal via useAddProjectDialog.show('existing', undefined, { initialPath }) instead of a /projects/new?path= URL.
autoDecisions.rationale: The page route has no path parameter today; the modal store already carries per-open options such as initialUrl.

autoDecisions.summary: --editor becomes an optional-value flag that works for any target, not only issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps today's behavior for issue ids and gives paths the same escape hatch with no extra flag.

autoDecisions.summary: panPath prefers the pan shim in <OVERDECK_HOME>/cli-bin, then PATH; Windows looks up pan.cmd/pan.exe; icon copied from the bundled favicon.svg.
autoDecisions.rationale: The shim is rewritten by pan install/sync so it survives npm reinstalls; process.argv[1] is a JS file, not an executable.

autoDecisions.summary: Changelog uses #### New and #### Improved (PRD originally said Changed).
autoDecisions.rationale: changelog.d/README.md allows only New, Improved and Fixed, and lint:docs rejects others.

autoDecisions.summary: no-loss-matrix rows use disposition OUT_OF_SCOPE (PRD originally said NEW).
autoDecisions.rationale: The Disposition union has no NEW value; OUT_OF_SCOPE with a note is the existing pattern for new non-domain surfaces.

New routes/ui-open.ts: makeUiOpenRoute(deps) with injectable {listProjects, listScratch, realpath, stat, resolveRoot, publish} defaulting to listProjectsAsync, listWorkspaces({kind:'scratch'}), node:fs/promises, resolveExplorerRoot, publishUiCommand (pattern: routes/linked-open.ts). Steps exactly as O-D3 1-7: 400 path-must-be-absolute / invalid-position; realpath+stat (404 not-found); candidates with realpath'd project and scratch paths (skip failures); resolvePathRoot; for root call resolveExplorerRoot(rootId) and relPath = POSIX relative(root.absPath, realPath); throw or '..' => no-root. Answers: 404 {error:'outside-projects', path, kind, suggestion:'pan project add <dir>'} (dir = folder itself or file's parent); 404 {error:'no-root', path, projectKey}; 200 {projectKey: root.projectKey, rootId, relPath, kind, line?, column?, delivered}. Unless dryRun publish {id: randomUUID(), type:'open-path', resolution}; dryRun => delivered 0. Never list a directory or read file contents. Export uiOpenRouteLayer and mount next to explorerRouteLayer in server.ts (~line 480). route-scopes.ts: {method:'POST', path:'/api/ui/open', scope:'operate'}. no-loss-matrix.ts: {surface:'POST /api/ui/open', kind:'http', disposition:'OUT_OF_SCOPE', door:'pan open (PAN-5349): resolves a path to an explorer root and publishes a UI command'}.
